asks: When did you last drink anything?
Do you know how far it has come?
Would you like to fill something?
description: Water coming out of a split in red stone and falling into a worn basin below it, clear and very cold, the way it has come out of that split for a great deal longer than there has been a room here.
emotes: {it} runs a little harder, for no reason, and eases off.
{it} throws a cold thread of spray across the floor.
{it} goes quiet, and then does not.
looks: The basin is worn a hand deep by the falling, and it took a long time to do that.
The water is so clear that the bottom looks closer than it is.
There's green growing in the wet crack above it, the only green in the room.
name: a spring coming out of the rock
says: Drink if you're going to. Don't waste it.
